title: Pastry Chef
desc: Lead bi-weekly flavor development. Craft, test, and refine new recipes that hit our feel-good standard.
responsibilities: Develop new flavors for the bi-weekly rotation. Maintain quality and consistency across all products. Work closely with the founder on recipe direction. Train kitchen team on new preparations.
requirements: 2+ years pastry experience. Passion for creative flavor development. Able to work in a fast-paced production kitchen. Portfolio of original recipes is a plus.
benefits: Monthly tasting sessions, birthday cake, wellness allowance, flexible hours
